rust_summary: A server player reaches deep sleep (`native_player_deep_sleep`).
doc_summary: A server player counts as deeply asleep after 100 ticks in a bed: `native_player_deep_sleep(player, name)` fires once at that point. Helpers looking the guest up through `self.lan` may find nothing during its tick. Bundles need "hooks": @API:player_deep_sleep@.
